What ratio describes the number of rhombuses to the total number of shapes?
question.worked_solution:
We count the number of rhombuses. We see that there are $4$ rhombuses.

We count the total number of shapes. We see that there are $8$ shapes in total.

So the ratio of rhombuses to total shapes is $4:8.$

We can simplify this ratio by dividing both numbers in a ratio by $4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\,\,4 &  & : & \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,8 &  \\ \,\,↓÷\,\,4 &  &  &  & \,\,\,↓÷\,\,4 &  \\ \,\,1 &  & : &  & \,\,\,2 & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the ratio of rhombuses to the total shapes is $1:2.$
